title: Render Handoff READMEs
description: Renders incident overviews, root READMEs, and job context markdown files from templates adhering to strict ASCII standards.
instruction: python3 tools/scripts/handoff/render_readme.py --findings=${findings}$([ -n "${mode}" ] && echo " --mode=${mode}")$([ -n "${output_file}" ] && echo " --output_file=${output_file}")$([ -n "${output_dir}" ] && echo " --output_dir=${output_dir}")$([ -n "${bucket}" ] && echo " --bucket=${bucket}")

mode.description: Render mode: incident, job, or readme
